user.title: Select existing Home Assistant entities
user.description: Controls existing Tesla Fleet entities using P1 export/import only. Single-phase charging, 5–10 A. No solar-production or forecast sensor required.

data_description.grid_net_power: Must be positive for grid import and negative for export, in watts.
data_description.charge_cable: Must be positively ON for wakes, starts, current and charge-limit changes. An active charge may receive a safety stop without waking.

init.title: Controller settings
init.description: Solar starts require 30 minutes of P1 export covering 5 A + 200 W. Stop after 30 continuous minutes importing at least 300 W at 5 A. Starts have no time-of-day restriction. Missing P1 data falls back to off-peak hours in both solar modes. Daily limits: 2 wakes, 2 solar sessions, 150 commands.

data_description.normal_target_soc: Applies to solar and off-peak. Charge ASAP always targets 100% at 10 A.
data_description.solar_wake_delta_soc: Applies to every solar start, including fresh plug-ins. Default: target minus 3 percentage points.
data_description.notify_service: Example: notify.mobile_app_tam14p. Leave empty to disable charging notifications.
